item.title: Hefner’s widow wants probe of Playboy founder’s private images, which contain nudes and maybe minors
item.description: Crystal Hefner says his diaries and scrapbooks never were intended for publication.

item.title: This week’s bestsellers at Southern California’s independent bookstores
item.description: See the top-selling hardcover and paperback fiction and nonfiction releases for the sales week that ended Feb. 15.

item.title: West Holllywood rally renews calls for Casey Wasserman to step down
item.description: Local elected officials, survivor advocates and attorneys gathered in West Hollywood Tuesday to renew calls for LA28 Chair Casey Wasserman to resign, one day after Mayor Bass said he "should step down."

item.title: UCLA men trounced by No. 15 Michigan State to close rough trip
item.description: The Bruins trail the Spartans by 20 at halftime and by as much as 31 in the second half of an 82-59 defeat that follows their 30-point loss to then-No. 2 Michigan over the weekend. Tempers flare late.

item.title: Report: Lakers’ Deandre Ayton briefly detained in Bahamas on suspicion of marijuana possession
item.description: The 27-year-old Ayton, in his native country for the All-Star break, was set to fly back to Los Angeles when authorities briefly detained him after he allegedly smoked marijuana on the premises, TMZ reports.

item.title: Flood advisory for Los Angeles and Ventura counties until Wednesday morning triggered by substantial rainfall
item.description: Los Angeles and Ventura counties are under a flood advisory which was released by the National Weather Service on Tuesday at 8:49 p.m. The advisory is in effect until Wednesday Feb. 18, at 6 a.m.

item.title: LAFC overwhelms Real España in CONCACAF Champions Cup opener
item.description: Denis Bouanga scores three goals as LAFC cruises to a 6-1 victory in Honduras in the first leg of the first-round matchup. LAFC will host the second leg next Tuesday night.

item.title: Notre Dame boys basketball wins battle with St. John Bosco in Open Division
item.description: Notre Dame advances to the next round in the CIF-SS Open Division playoffs while St. John Bosco will try Friday to earn a spot in the state playoffs.
